headings.text: Five topics to confirm before a quotation

main:
Resources
Delivery planning
Shipping CNC parts internationally

Agree packing, documents and transport responsibilities alongside the machining work.

On this page
Five topics to confirm before a quotation
Part protection
Information you provide

Mark cosmetic faces, sealing surfaces, threads, fragile edges, cleanliness and corrosion-protection needs. Specify pack weight or quantity limits and receiving-site handling requirements.

Confirm in the quotation

Agree protective materials, separation between parts and protection for threads and mating surfaces. Cartons or wooden cases depend on the part, quantity and transport route.

Pack identification
Information you provide

Part number, drawing revision, quantity per pack, batch identification and required labels.

Confirm in the quotation

Confirm available label, lot-reference and inspection-document formats. Use the same part and revision references on the packing list and agreed quality records.

Delivery basis
Information you provide

Full delivery address, receiving contact, required arrival date, requested trade term/version and named place.

Confirm in the quotation

Confirm who books transport and handles export/import clearance, insurance, duties, taxes and local delivery. EXW, FOB or DDP options are quoted for the applicable destination and service.

DDP is not an automatic inclusion.

Documents
Information you provide

The document list required by procurement, logistics or your destination-side import contact.

Confirm in the quotation

We provide protective packing, a packing list, commercial invoice and shipment information. Material, finishing and dimensional records are included when specified in the order. Confirm which documents are available and who prepares each.

Schedule
Information you provide

Separate your required arrival date from the desired dispatch date.

Confirm in the quotation

Production takes 7–14 business days after drawing and order confirmation, including surface finishing. Transit is estimated separately and is not included in production time.

Transport options and import documents

LZZ packing archive · November 2022. Packing varies by part, quantity and route. These images do not establish a customer, destination, carrier, trade term or delivery outcome for a new order.
